name: ═══════════════ 421 IRRIGATION STATUS (mobile UI) ═══════════════
info:
## Irrigation status dashboard

**Flow:** 421-irrigation-status-dashboard.json

### MQTT
- `stat/IrigationSystem/#` — zones + 24V
- `stat/pompaApa/POWER1` — pump relay (timers)
- `tele/pompaApa/STATE` — Tasmota JSON → **pump web link** (`http://<IP>/`)
- 1s inject — refresh **running** elapsed times

### Timers
Flow context stores start/end/duration per zone and pump (OFF→ON / ON→OFF edges).
Each zone card shows **Started**, **Ended**, **Duration** (running elapsed while ON; last completed run while OFF).

### Event log
Up to **25** recent state changes (newest first): pump, zones, 24V — timestamp + icon + text.

### Areas
**A:** I1–I10. **B:** I11 & I12.
